title: fix(platform-objects): decide the dataset panel en-echoes per leaf, and derive the panel pin
body:
Part of #19403

Clause-②: no

## What this is

Round 3 of this card. One panel family, decided **leaf by leaf**. The card's deliverable is a per-leaf judgement with its reason recorded, not 24 translations; every leaf below was decided on its own evidence, and the verdicts with their reasons live in a ledger the suite reads (`dataset-panel-echo-decisions.test.ts`), not only in this body.

**The family: the whole `dataset` metadata form** — the ADR-0021 analytics semantic-layer editor. Its type display pair, its four section headings, and both string leaves of its seven non-repeater fields. It is the largest family the round-2 table left (12 of the 50 keys), and round 2's stated rule was to take that one.

Not `Fixes` — this is one family of the card's population, and the card outlives this round. **Six families remain** (38 label keys), tabled at the foot of this body.

## The reading, re-taken on this base — the numbers are NOT inherited

Census instrument: flatten every `*.metadata-forms.generated.ts` bundle and compare `.label` leaves against the `en` bundle. Population fixed here: the `.label` leaves of the metadata-form catalogs (the card's population, 538 leaves), **plus the sibling `helpText` leaf of every key this round decides, plus the `label` + `description` pair of every section heading this family sits under, plus the type's own display pair** — a panel whose field name is Chinese and whose tooltip is English is the same defect half fixed.

Measured on worktree base `2951c0f8f`:

| reading | result |
|:--|:--|
| `en` string leaves in the metadata-form catalogs | 893 |
| of which `.label` leaves | 538 |
| POSITIVE CONTROL — labels genuinely translated | **488** (`zh-CN`) · **472** (`ja-JP`) · **472** (`es-ES`) |
| labels echoing the `en` source, per locale | 50 · 66 · 66 |
| label keys echoing in ALL THREE locales | **50** ⇒ 150 leaves |

The control is what makes the echo count mean something: 488 translated against 50 echoing is a discrimination, not a parser that matches everything.

**This is 50 / 150, the same reading round 2's LANDED comment recorded on the trunk and the same the round-3 claim re-took at 23:01Z** — but that is a *measurement here*, not an inheritance: four commits landed on `origin/main` between my base and my first push (`04d639c65`, `fc1a79067`, `be488cef3`, `8e368dc3b`) and `git diff 2951c0f8f..origin/main -- packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/` is **empty**, so nothing moved this population under me. The card's own banner exists because a sibling PR once did exactly that; the way to know is to look.

**After this change**: 38 keys / 114 leaves echo in all three locales; control **500** · **484** · **484** — echoes down 12 and the control up 12, same population, same run.

## The re-derived family table — the round-2 table is NOT stale

The claim said to treat PR #19428's seven-family breakdown as a starting hypothesis and re-derive it. Re-derived from the census output on base `2951c0f8f`, grouping the 50 keys by metadata type: the two tables agree **key for key**, including its decision to collect the six bare `type.label` keys with no panel (`seed` · `mapping` · `api` · `doc` · `book` · `capability`) into one row. So the table is a live reading, not a stale one, and the largest family it leaves is this one.

One thing the re-derivation exposes that a `.label` census cannot: **12 label keys is 24 decidable leaves here**, because every one of them has a sibling `helpText` or `description` that echoes with it and that no `.label` census counts. That ratio is what the remaining-count table at the foot is worth reading against.

## The verdicts — 12 keys × 2 string leaves × 3 locales = 72 decisions

Every one is `translate`, and **not one of them is "translate because it is English"**. The echo direction was tested per leaf by asking what this catalog's own authored corpus answers for that term.

- **The authored twin INSIDE the same key.** `dataset.fields.measures` was already authored in all three locales (度量 / メジャー / Medidas, helpText included) while `dataset.sections.measures` — the heading directly over it — read English; `dataset.fields.dimensions` read English while its own five row properties were authored; `dataset.fields.measures.filter` was 筛选 / フィルター / Filtro while `dataset.fields.filter` echoed; `dataset.fields.measures.name` / `.label` were authored while `dataset.fields.name` / `.label` echoed. The identical string, on the same panel, rendered one way and echoed the other. An echo cannot be the deliberate rendering when the same word is rendered beside it.
- **The sibling editor.** `datasetForm`'s own docblock says it "Mirrors `reportForm` — the sibling analytics editor", and `report` is authored in all three locales for the same identity fields (`snake_case unique identifier` is an exact-string precedent, byte for byte), the same section shape, and the same semantic-layer vocabulary (`semantic layer`, `measures/dimensions`).
- **Decided AGAINST its precedents, per locale** — `dataset.sections.source.label`. This catalog answers the bare word `Source` in three directions: `hook.fields.body.source` is 源码 / ソース / Código fuente (source CODE), `sys_metadata.fields.source` is 来源 / ソース / Origen (provenance), and `page.fields.interfaceConfig.source` is 数据来源 / ソース / Origen de datos (a data binding — decided one round earlier on this same card). This section holds the base object, the joins and the intrinsic scope, so it is the third sense and neither of the first two. `zh-CN` and `es-ES` depart from two of the three precedents; `ja-JP` keeps ソース, which all three precedents already use and which carries the data-source sense unambiguously in Japanese. Per locale, not per string.
- **The one leaf with NO precedent at all** — `dataset.fields.include.label`. Nothing in either catalog answers the bare word `Include`, so it is decided from its own helpText and the decision is recorded **as an expansion**: 包含关联 / 含める関係 / Relaciones a incluir, using this catalog's own authored words for the concept (`report.sections.joined_blocks.label` is 关联对象 / 結合ブロック / Bloques unidos; `field.fields.summaryOperations.helpText` renders parent-child relationships as 父子关系 / 親子関係 / `relaciones padre-hijo`). A bare 包含 / 含める / Incluir answers "include what?" with nothing on a panel whose other labels all name their content.
- **Strict-enum values kept English, schema checked BEFORE translating** — `dataset.sections.measures.description` names `sum/avg/count/…` and `ratio/sum/difference/product`. Those are `AggregationFunction` (`packages/spec/src/data/query.zod.ts:159`) and `DerivedMeasureOp` (`packages/spec/src/ui/dataset.zod.ts:136`), both `z.enum` inside a `strictObject`. Rendering them as words would tell an author in their own language to write a token the schema refuses — the inverse defect round 2 found on `view.fields.userFilters.helpText` and recorded as #19430. Kept English on this catalog's own authored precedent for the shape: `report.fields.type.helpText` keeps `tabular/summary/matrix/joined` verbatim in all three locales.
- **Machine tokens and SQL keywords kept English inside translated prose** — `lookup` / `master_detail` (FieldType enum values), `relationship.field` and its worked example `account.region`, the literal example value `account`, and the `FROM` / `ON` clauses the prose names. Precedents: `object.fields.fields.reference.helpText` keeps `tree` and `lookup` verbatim in all three locales, `field.fields.multiple.helpText` keeps `select/lookup`, and `view.fields.appearance.helpText` keeps `allowedVisualizations`.
- **A house style measured rather than assumed** — of the 67 genuinely-translated section descriptions in this catalog, `zh-CN` drops the trailing full stop in 56 while `ja-JP` and `es-ES` keep it in all 67. The four new section descriptions follow that.
- **Panel-internal control** for every prose leaf: each of the 24 carried an entry in this package's per-locale `source-hashes.generated.ts` provenance table in all three locales — exactly 24 rows under `metadataForms.dataset` per locale, no more and no fewer — while all 15 authored neighbours in the same `dataset` block (`measures.label`, `measures.helpText` and the thirteen repeater row properties) carried none in any of them. That is what an unauthored extractor fill looks like here.

Per-leaf reasons for all 24 leaves are in the ledger; this list is the summary, not the record.

## The instrument, extended not reinvented

`dataset-panel-echo-decisions.test.ts` is the #19355 shape as rounds 1 and 2 left it: one row per leaf, verdict per locale, reason, and the `en` source pinned EQUAL to the live bundle so rewording the English reds the row instead of leaving a decision standing over text nobody judged. All three of round 2's deliberate properties are carried over:

1. **The echo-reason rule is a predicate with a dark control.** Every verdict here is `translate`, so asserting the rule over the ledger alone evaluates nothing — the suite feeds it a synthetic `echo` row, asserts it is refused, then asserts it is accepted once a departure reason is added.
2. **The panel population is DERIVED from the `en` catalog**, not hand-listed, so the pin cannot drift into a maintained list. It reaches all 39 string leaves of the `dataset` entry (the 24 decided plus the 15 already authored), and the dark control feeds it the `en` catalog and requires every leaf to come back flagged.
3. **A SECOND, independent witness: the provenance table.** The ledger asserts that no decided leaf is still recorded as an extractor fill in any of the three `source-hashes.generated.ts` companions. It fires on a different trigger than the catalog assertion (a re-fill followed by an extract, rather than the re-fill itself) and it is per-locale, so it is not blind in the case `check:i18n-stale-fill`'s cross-locale witness is blind. Its own dark control proves the lookup finds a key the table *does* hold, matched by pattern rather than pinned to a family, so a later round cannot red it by repairing one — and it additionally pins both spellings the composer builds, since this family is the first to need a type-level key (`metadataForms.dataset.label`) beside the `fields`/`sections` form.

**The blind spot this family adds — a third shape, measured from both sides.** Round 1 measured the `record` blind spot and round 2 the `composite` one. Here `dataset` *is* one of the types `repeater-row-properties.test.ts` already derives: its two enumerated repeaters yield **13** row properties (`dimensions.*` ×5, `measures.*` ×8), and **every one of those 13 was already translated in all three locales**. None of the 24 leaves decided here is inside that derivation, because the pin walks a repeater's CHILDREN and never the repeater itself — so `dataset.fields.dimensions.label` and `.helpText` sat directly above thirteen covered row properties and no pin saw them. The suite asserts both halves: what the existing pin covers (and that it was fine), and what it structurally cannot.

## Regeneration — the silent-loss hazard on this path

Translated-locale values are hand-written; the provenance tables are not. Regenerated with **`pnpm i18n:extract`** (the command this package's extract config documents), never by hand, and **no key was added or removed** — so the `merge=os-regen` gap on `*.metadata-forms.generated.ts` (`git check-attr merge` reads `unspecified` on these paths) has nothing to lose even in principle.

Measured rather than asserted: the bundle diff is **24 insertions / 24 deletions** in each of the three translated bundles — a pure value replacement — and the key lines of all four bundles are byte-identical lists before and after (**1465** in each, same order, `diff` clean). The extract's own diff is **0 insertions / 24 deletions** per provenance table: the 24 rows per locale that now record these leaves as authored (table sizes 455 → 431, 509 → 485, 518 → 494, exactly −24 each; **0** rows remain under `metadataForms.dataset` in any locale, while the tables still hold rows for other families). The `en` bundle and all four `*.objects.generated.ts` bundles are untouched.

`pnpm check:i18n` green is the proof that the hand-written values are byte-identical to what a fresh extract writes, across all nine bundle sets.

## Reverse verification — the new pin can fail, in three independent places

Committed first, then ablated through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, which makes the anchor count and the blob hash its own verdict and performs the mutation, the run and the restore **inside one process** — so no restore can be lost to a shell that exited between the two. No rebuild is needed for these: the ledger imports the bundles by relative path inside its own package, so the ablated files do not resolve through a package `exports` to `dist/`; this package's one vitest alias is for `@objectstack/lint` and touches none of it. (The ledger's one cross-package import, `datasetForm` from `@objectstack/spec/ui`, does resolve to `spec/dist` — it is not an ablation subject, and that dist was rebuilt on this base before any reading was taken.)

**Ablation A — one decided leaf reverted to its English source in `zh-CN`** (`dataset.fields.include.label`):

- anchor `label: "包含关联",` x1 → x0 · replacement `label: "Include",` x0 → x1 · blob `6cadd2c0231a` → `a0f356e5270f`
- suite under the mutation: **2 failed | 17 passed** — the enumerated verdict (`zh-CN: every decided leaf matches its verdict`) AND the derived panel pin (`no leaf on this panel reads its en source unless the ledger decided it is an echo`), independently
- restored: blob back to `6cadd2c0231a` == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty

**Ablation B — one provenance row re-pointed at a decided leaf** (a row's key swapped in `zh-CN.source-hashes.generated.ts`, so the table claims the leaf is still a byte copy of its source):

- anchor x1 → x0 · replacement x0 → x1 · blob `d279b182827b` → `bbe9b563ba54`
- suite under the mutation: **1 failed | 18 passed** — and it is a **different** assertion than A's two (`zh-CN: no decided leaf is still recorded as an extractor fill`), so the second witness is not a restatement of the first
- restored: blob back to `d279b182827b` == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty

Suite restored and re-run: **19 passed**, working tree clean.

## Verification

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects test` — 46 files, **647 passed** (628 before; +19 from the new ledger)
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects typecheck` — **exit 0**. Its `tsconfig.test.json` program reaches the new file (`--listFiles` names it; 46 of 46 of this package's test files are in that program) and it contributes **0** errors — the only test-layer errors are the three pre-existing signatures `test-typecheck-debt.json` already records for `src/feature-gate-guard.test.ts`. The build config `tsconfig.json` excludes `*.test.ts` by design, so it names the new file 0 times; that is the shape, not a gap
- `pnpm check:i18n` — **green**, 9 packages in sync. Its first run exited **3** (PREREQUISITE NOT MET), which is not a reading; cleared by building the closure the gate itself names, then re-run green
- `pnpm lint` — repo-wide, `eslint . --no-inline-config`, **exit 0**, at `edfef935d` (the head of this branch; no commit has landed on it since that run)
- Gate families derived with `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` and reconciled with `--ran` carrying every exit code, each captured BEFORE any pipe: **60 derived · 59 run green · 0 unrun · 1 NOT MEASURED** — `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exits 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: it reads built output for every package in the repo and names twelve with no `dist/`). That prerequisite is a whole-repo build, which is CI's `Build Core`, and this diff adds no package and changes no export
- The first two derivations printed **STALE TREE** (4 commits behind `origin/main`, 2 of the files the families are derived from changed across that range). Discharged by merging `origin/main` and re-deriving from the merged tree, not by waving it off; the re-derived list is identical and the merge brought no change to `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/` and no lockfile movement

## Changeset, measured

`@objectstack/platform-objects` declares no `private` and ships `files: ["dist", …]`, and `src/metadata-translations/index.ts` imports all three translated bundles. Probed on the built output: four new leaves are present in `dist/metadata-translations/index.js`, `dist/index.js` **and** `dist/plugin.js` — 数据集 as `数据集`, 含める関係 as `含める関係`, `Capa sem\xE1ntica de anal\xEDtica`, and the plain-ASCII `Relaciones a incluir` — with two pre-existing translated leaves as positive controls (度量, メジャー, 15 hits each) and two negative controls: an invented string (**0**) and the **raw un-escaped** spelling of the same CJK strings (**0**, including for the positive controls). ⇒ the diff publishes, `skip-changeset` would be wrong, and a **`patch`** changeset is included.

That probe is written to round 2's sharpened lesson and confirms both halves of it in one run: esbuild emits **UPPER-CASE** hex in `\uXXXX`, and `\xNN` for U+0080–U+00FF — `Capa semántica de analítica` is only findable as `Capa sem\xE1ntica de anal\xEDtica`. The raw negative control is in the probe so the next reader can see that a zero means "escaped", not "absent".

## The six families that remain (38 label keys, all-three-locale echoes, this base)

| family | keys |
|:--|--:|
| `object.fields.enable.*` (+ `validations`) — the object capabilities panel | 9 |
| `field.fields.*` — the standalone field panel (several keys have a precedent from round 1) | 9 |
| `action.fields.body.*` + `action.fields.ai` | 6 |
| metadata-type display names with no panel: `seed` · `mapping` · `api` · `doc` · `book` · `capability` | 6 |
| `hook.fields.retryPolicy.*` + `hook.fields.body.memoryMb` + `hook.fields.timeoutMs` | 5 |
| `report.fields.drilldown` + `report.fields.runtimeFilter` + `report.sections.dataset_binding` | 3 |

The `dataset` type is now absent from the echo census **and** from the `metadataForms.dataset.*` half of all three provenance tables — 0 rows remain there, where 24 per locale stood on this base.

⚠️ For whoever sizes the rest: the `.label` census under-counts the decidable population by roughly half, because each label key carries a sibling `helpText` or `description` that echoes with it. This family was 12 keys and 24 leaves; the largest row left (9 keys) is plausibly 18, and the six bare `type.label` keys carry a `type.description` each.

## Acceptance notes

No class (a), (b) or (c) finding was produced by this family, and that is a reading rather than a silence — the one place this family could have carried the #19430 trap was checked directly. `dataset.sections.measures.description` names two strict enums' legal values in prose; both schemas were read before any word was translated (`AggregationFunction`, `DerivedMeasureOp`), and the tokens were kept English, so no author is told to write a value the schema refuses. `dataset.fields.measures.helpText` (authored before this round) already keeps `count` the same way. Nothing else on this panel names an enum's values in prose.

Noted, not filed:

- **The repeater blind spot, third shape.** `repeater-row-properties.test.ts` filters on `spec.type === 'repeater'` and walks a repeater's declared CHILDREN. Round 1 measured the `record` blind spot and round 2 the `composite` one; here the repeater itself is covered — 13 row properties derived for `dataset`, all already translated — while the repeater's own `label` and `helpText` are structurally outside it, as are every section heading and the type display pair. Closed for THIS panel by the derived pin this PR adds; the shape remains for any other repeater parent. Successor: the remaining-family rounds, each of which will meet it.
- **`report.sections.*` descriptions.** The population the card records as having no home. `report.sections.dataset_binding.label` IS counted by the `.label` census (it is in the remaining table's last row), but the `description` half of every `report.sections.*` pair is counted by no census and seen by no pin — the same asymmetry this round's 12-keys-to-24-leaves ratio measures generally. Successor: the `report` family row above, if the seat dispatches it.
- **`field.fields.summaryOperations.object.label`** echoes `Object` while five authored precedents in this catalog answer 对象 / オブジェクト / Objeto. It was read while judging this family's own `dataset.fields.object.label` and deliberately NOT used as evidence for it; it belongs to the `field` family row above and is left there untouched. Successor: the `field` family round.
- **The eight bundle sets other than this one still do not opt into the provenance table** (`--source-hashes`), so their generated leaves stay legacy-trusted and no per-leaf control like this round's exists for them. Documented in the extract config as deliberate; not this card's. 承接者：无.
